_comment: The harness kinds a harness placement may name in NOO_HARNESS_KIND, declared ONCE. The gateway (gateway-rust/src/harness_kinds.rs) validates placements against it, the node agent embeds a byte-equal copy (node-agent-go/internal/reconcile/harness_kinds.json, held equal by TestHarnessKindsTableMatchesTheShippedFile) for wire compatibility, runner presence and vendor telemetry switches, and the noo CLI checks --kind against it. kind: the NOO_HARNESS_KIND value. wire: the API the harness speaks. wires: the node chat backend types that serve it (empty = no node backend serves it yet). runner: the executable the applier installs beside the agent (null = no runner ships yet; the node agent refuses the kind). telemetry_off: the vendor telemetry switches the runner must launch it with, merged after any placement value (docs/security/telemetry.md, Agent harnesses); every kind has an entry, empty when there is nothing to switch off or none is declared yet.
